overview_description.description:
Forto is a leading disruptor in the European freight forwarding industry. We are revolutionizing the industry through cutting-edge technology, AI-driven automation, and integrated system solutions. 

Our strategy is focused on delivering an exceptional, seamless customer experience built on operational excellence. By executing a value-based sales approach, we elevate the impact of technology-powered processes and people, driving sustainable growth and innovation.
